_comment: Each source declares what it is AUTHORITATIVE FOR. Feeds are facts; messages are claims: a payment 'exists' when the bank feed shows it, a price when the market feed shows it — never when a screenshot says so. auth_env names an environment variable holding a bearer token; credentials never live in the repo.

sources.name: bank-feed
sources.authoritative_for: payments: a client payment is confirmed when the credit appears here as POSTED

sources.name: fx-rates
sources.authoritative_for: exchange rates used in any quote or report
